Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Luke Kennard?

Luke Kennard is 30 years old.

Where was Luke Kennard born?

Luke Kennard was born in Middletown, Ohio.

When was Luke Kennard born?

Luke Kennard was born on June 24, 1996.

How tall is Luke Kennard?

Luke Kennard is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Luke Kennard weigh?

Luke Kennard weighs 206 lbs (93 kg).

Is Luke Kennard in the Hall of Fame?

Luke Kennard is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Luke Kennard drafted?

Luke Kennard was drafted by Detroit Pistons, 1st round (12th pick, 12th overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does Luke Kennard play?

Shooting Guard.

What is Luke Kennard's net worth?

Luke Kennard has made at least $77,292,000 playing professional basketball.

How much does Luke Kennard make?

Luke Kennard made $14,763,636 in 2024.

How many rings does Luke Kennard have?

Luke Kennard has won 0 championships.

What is Luke Kennard's Instagram account?

Luke Kennard is on Instagram at lukekennard5.

What schools did Luke Kennard attend?

Luke Kennard attended Franklin in Franklin, Ohio and Duke.

What are Luke Kennard's nicknames?

Cool Hand Luke, Duck are nicknames for Luke Kennard.
